reason: My manager already brings me deals, and I've got Collabstr and Beacons for inbound stuff. A new app with only a few small brands isn't worth adding another 10% cut on top of what my manager takes.
objection: At my size the money is in bigger brand deals my manager negotiates, not $500 TikToks from small businesses. Hardly any brands are on it yet, so it'd be another profile to keep up for almost no bookings.
would_change_my_mind: If real, bigger brands were posting briefs there at rates near what my manager gets me, and my manager could run the account so the escrow becomes a perk instead of an extra platform.
